title: WORK-LAB local runtime registry — which serving processes exist, how they are launched, and what they can serve
purpose: Declare the local inference runtimes once. Projects must never launch their own copy of a runtime; they call a logical provider from provider-registry.json, which maps onto a runtime declared here.

policy.noDuplicateServers: Do not install a second runtime that only repeats what a declared runtime already does.
policy.noGlobalConfigRewrite: Starting/stopping a runtime is per-session process control; global product config is never rewritten by the model control plane.

capabilityRoles.lmstudio: Primary desktop runtime for this work package: GUI + OpenAI-compatible API on 1234 + `lms` CLI lifecycle; indexes the shared library in place.
capabilityRoles.ollama: Ollama-managed GGUFs: chat/completions, embeddings; simple model lifecycle by name. No rerank endpoint in 0.34.3.
capabilityRoles.llamacpp: Raw GGUF files with explicit offload control (-ngl / --n-cpu-moe), OpenAI-compatible /v1 server, precise context and KV control, and the only runtime here that serves /v1/rerank.

runtimes.version_observed: LM Studio desktop; CLI commit 69d945a; app at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\LM Studio
runtimes.endpoint_note: %USERPROFILE%\.lmstudio\.internal\http-server.json also lists a separate app-service port (observed 41343) whose /v1/models returns 404 — that is NOT the inference endpoint; the OpenAI-compatible server is 1234 after `lms server start`.

model_index.no_import_needed: LM Studio already indexed both target GGUFs in place. `lms import` was NOT used, so no copy/move/link happened and the single-physical-copy rule is intact. (`lms import` does support -L/--hard-link and -l/--symbolic-link if a future model is not auto-indexed.)

gpu.backend: llama.cpp runtime managed by LM Studio

runtimes.critical_runtime_difference: For qwen3.5-4b this runtime IGNORES `chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false}` AND the `/no_think` prompt token: reasoning_content consumes the entire max_tokens budget and content stays empty (reproduced 3x). `reasoning_effort: "none"` DOES work (verified: 600 content chars, reasoning_tokens 0). Callers porting from llama.cpp must switch parameters.
runtimes.status_evidence: `lms server start` -> 'Server is now running on port 1234'; GET /v1/models listed qwen3.5-4b, qwen3.8-27b, text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5; `lms load qwen3.5-4b` succeeded; real Chinese generation measured
runtimes.user_decision: Selected as the PRIMARY runtime for the 2026-09-28 work package (desktop operation + API/CLI automation + background running), explicitly without breaking the existing Ollama service.
runtimes.status_note: Not yet used for DEEP; the 27B load was not exercised on this runtime in this round.
